# Independent re-review of 2669ec4
Reviewer: OpenAI/Codex, GPT-6 model family; revision author: Codex.
The export manifest marks reports [146](exports/reports/146.json), [147](exports/reports/147.json) and [150](exports/reports/150.json) downloaded; all were read, with the author's account treated as a lead.
Tree confirmed: the protocol's latest commit is `2669ec4bcfcb86f1fabf86c51cf4acdfd153ebb3`; the working protocol matches it exactly, and `git diff cf38154 2669ec4 -- benchmark/protocol.md` confirms the intended nonempty revision.
Independent verification: `python3 -I policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` exited 0 with errors=[], evidence_references=8 and manifest=indexed. This establishes index integrity only.
## Standards
No documented standards violation found in the assigned context; the revision is localized to accounting, reader observations and their baseline/challenge integration. No repository or evaluator changes were made by this review.
## Spec
**F1 — closed as a protocol requirement:** [tasks, lines 28–42](../benchmark/protocol.md#tasks) freezes independent answer/observation inventories, assertion mapping, dimension outcomes and denominators; [baseline, lines 84–86](../benchmark/protocol.md#baseline) pins them before either arm runs.
Omissions retain required slots; true extras cannot replace them; false extras and contradictions make the affected dimension incorrect; duplicates earn credit once. Extra ledgers never enlarge required denominators. Missing, unsupported, unverified and error outcomes cannot become full passes; empty reference inventories are unverified.
[Challenges, lines 100–102](../benchmark/protocol.md#challenges) prescribe discriminating omission, extra-false-claim and duplicate/contradiction tests, including true and unverified extras. No remaining F1 correction is identified at this design stage.
**F2 — closed as a protocol requirement:** [tasks, lines 38–39](../benchmark/protocol.md#tasks) freezes independent probes, scope, ordering/branches, native alignment and raw request/output/error evidence; [baseline, lines 85–86](../benchmark/protocol.md#baseline) requires separate probe sessions and complete ledgers, with agent-selected calls supplementary.
[Challenges, lines 103–104](../benchmark/protocol.md#challenges) exercise constant, empty, truncated, unsupported and failed outputs. Absent observations remain missing, operational failures remain recorded and successful wrappers earn no fidelity credit. No remaining F2 correction is identified.
Regression review found no new conflict with [evaluation requirements](../docs/perpetua/evaluation.md), [the goal](../goal/goal.md), or the protocol's oracle, split isolation, matched baseline, challenges and coverage reporting. Separate probe costs and no-tool fidelity marked not applicable preserve the comparison's scope.
Native observations, independently checked keys, executable scoring, challenge execution and matched runs remain outstanding. The check reports benchmark_executed=false, benchmark_ready=false, tool_quality=null and missing tasks/oracle/split/baseline/challenges; family/version gaps and unmeasured quality remain explicit.
Next: Policymaker can consider this commit-bound review and order authorized development evidence and scorer work with independent verification. Reuse this review and staged reports; avoid repeating source scans or treating index validity as measured quality.
Overall recommendation: **accept the F1/F2 documentation revision at 2669ec4**. This recommendation establishes neither benchmark readiness, owner acceptance of the complete method, nor authorization to begin product implementation.

No changes to merge.
